scripts.speaker: Guillaume Blacksmith
scripts.text:
We are in urgency! The Barricade has been destroyed!
We can repair the Barricade with ^3131FF50 Stones, 3 Sinew of Bear, 500 Metal Fragments, 30 Rough Elunium and 100 Gold.^000000
We have it all except for the 50 Stones!
Repair.
Leave it.

scripts.speaker: Guillaume Blacksmith
scripts.text: You brought enough stones! Let's go and repair.

scripts.speaker: Guillaume Blacksmith
scripts.text: Combine Stones and Gold in the proper percentage.

scripts.speaker: Guillaume Blacksmith
scripts.text: Combine Stones and Gold in the proper percentage and shape the Barricade.

scripts.speaker: Guillaume Blacksmith
scripts.text: Combine Stones and Gold in the proper percentage and shape the Barricade, then add Rough Elunium to make it stronger.

scripts.speaker: Guillaume Blacksmith
scripts.text: Combine Stones and Gold in the proper percentage and shape the Barricade, then add Rough Elunium to make it stronger. Now decorate with Metal Fragments.

scripts.speaker: Guillaume Blacksmith
scripts.text: Combine Stones and Gold in the proper percentage and shape the Barricade, then add Rough Elunium to make it stronger. Decorate with Metal Fragments, and plait stones with Sinew of Bear!

scripts.speaker: Guillaume Blacksmith
scripts.text:
Wow! It's done.
We are relieved.

scripts.speaker: Guillaume Blacksmith
scripts.text: You don't have enough Stones!

scripts.speaker: Guillaume Blacksmith
scripts.text:
^3131FFWe need 50 Stones.^000000
We are busy, so please hurry.

scripts.speaker: Guillaume Blacksmith
scripts.text: There are enemies coming! Let's evacuate from here!

scripts.speaker: Guillaume Blacksmith
scripts.text: There the enemy is coming!
